gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G02 (map=22, 1541x1080, land=664,497, 6 teams, H=61), pre-d590acd findVirtualSquadAnchor + clusterMax<=350 caused 4 of 8 bots (mark07, ethan21, ryan_m, noah88) to fail minVoronoi and hit the voronoi=500 fallback, scattering the squad across 6 disconnected landmasses: only 2/8 bots (mark07, leo_tx) spawned on the 244,592px main continent, while ethan21 was trapped on a 275px micro-island (1480,748) and dave_w on a 2,331px island (452,72). During t=600..1500, V3 opening bottlenecks (dpKeep uncapped against human neighbors + minCmd>=4.69%B blocking 18/44 neutral-border snapshots) capped squad land at L_team(1530)=80,132 (12.06% of map, d_avg=7.1). At inflection t=1800..2070, dave_w collapsed on his island (L: 5,443->0), ryan_m (L=17,130, 183 cmds, d=2.5->9.7) was overrun at t=2356 when Team 1 already held 204,109px (30.7%), and lucas94/kevin_k burned 43.3% of their balances firing 14 sea-intercept boats (t=3000..3200) before Team 1 swept the map (356,396px, 53.6%).

In G03 (map=17, 690x925, land=292,727, 4 teams, H=58), all 8 bots spawned on the single 291,709px main continent (99.65% of map), but fd868f3 compressed allyMinSep to 88px (relaxing to 48px between kevin_k (604,322) and noah88 (644,296)) and clusterMax<=289px, packing all 8 brothers into a 230x324px corner box (11.7% of map area). In t=600..1499, V3 opening bottlenecks blocked 30 of 41 neutral-border snapshots (73.2% blocked; only 15/72 DP cycles fired in cyc 6..14) because bordering 10~17 human neighbors inflated dpKeep(g) above dpSpend*bal, freezing lucas94 at L=4,411 (neut=10 ungrabbed for 450 ticks) and ethan21 at L=7,292 (neut=11 ungrabbed), then triggering 17 duplicate expandNeutral commands at t=1500..1526 that burned ~34.8k troops for 38px. By t=1530, L_squad=60,318 (20.61%) was 24% below the >=27% 4-team survival threshold, and 3/8 bots (kevin_k, dave_w, noah88, 22,188px=36.8% of squad land) were 100% boxed-in (nb=0, neut=0). At inflection t=1800..2024, frontline guard mark07 (L=10,573, d=4.9->6.2) was crushed at t=2024 while the 3 boxed-in rear bots sat at d=49..78 until t=2700 and then burned 812k in 6.25%B donation tax across 43 micro-donations.

variableEvaluations.recommendedOptimalValue: 1) In dpNeutral(g): cap dpKeep at 0.55*bal while this.neutral > 0, relax effMinCmd to Math.min(this.minCmd(g), Math.max(120, 2*fee)) when n === rings.length (finite pocket), and bypass later>=n wait when n === rings.length && rings.length <= 6 && g.t >= 500; 2) In expandNeutral(g): remove minGrab=Math.min(0.22*B, 10*neutral+3000) override when have >= 2*neutral, and remove the duplicate pre-buyLand expandNeutral call at v27-team-live.js:5335; 3) Restore P.period = 5
variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: Four stacked code defects crippled V3 opening neutral land harvest (t=0..1500) and the t=1500 transition: (1) In dpNeutral (v27-team-live.js:2367, 2435), dpKeep(g) = (max_nb_human_B - 1.5*L)/1.78 is uncapped; in dense Team games where a bot borders 5..17 human neighbors (e.g. G03 lucas94 nb=14, leo_tx nb=17), a single passive neighbor with B=25k pushes dpKeep above 0.5*B, making max = min(0.5*B, B - dpKeep) - fee <= 0 and completely freezing neutral expansion from t=600 to t=1499 (blocking 73.2% of neutral snapshots in G03 and 53.9% across G00-G09); (2) Line 2381 (if (X < this.minCmd(g)) return) requires X >= 4.69% * B, so finite neutral pockets of 3..25px (costing 7..51 troops) are ignored for 500+ ticks while bots sit with neut=3..24; (3) At t=1500 (P.coreFrom), act(g) calls expandNeutral TWICE per tick (lines 5337 and 5350) with minGrab = Math.min(0.22*B, max(minCmd+50, 10*neutral+3000)) and period=2 / inflight<2t, firing 5..12 duplicate commands across WebSocket RTT before neutral troops land and burning 15k..35k troops + 8..14% tax for a few pixels; (4) Coupled with V1 (pre-d590acd island anchor + relax<0.60 dropping minViableCompSize) and V2 (allyMinSep<=112, clusterMax<=350), the squad's reachable neutral envelope is cut by 35%..55% before t=600.

topCoreVariableRanking.oneLineReason: oppFloorCap=38 + collapseFloorCap=16 + totB=B+myOut drained frontline home density to d=2.5..9.7 (ryan_m in G02, mark07/leo_tx in G03), causing instant frontline collapse against d=65..95 enemies.

Uncapped dpKeep + minCmd>=4.69%B blocked 53.9% of t=600..1499 neutral-border snapshots (73.2% in G03), and the t=1500 double-expandNeutral + minGrab bug burned 15k..35k troops, keeping L_team(1500)/L_map well below the 80%-winrate survival line.

Pre-d590acd VirtualSquadAnchor + relax<0.60 dropping minViableCompSize + voronoi=500 fallback scattered 4/8 bots in G02 across 6 islands (including 275px and 2,331px traps), forfeiting 63% of the main continent at t=0.
fd868f3 compressed allyMinSep to 62..112px (relaxing to 48px in G03) and clusterMax<=350px, boxing 3/8 bots in G03 (36.8% of squad land) into nb=0, neut=0 internal lockup by t=1260.

Boxed-in rear bots in G03 (kevin_k, dave_w, noah88) were blocked from donating until dMe>=72 (t=2700, 676 ticks after mark07 died) and burned 55.2% of donated troops to the flat 6.25%B engine tax via pct=51 micro-donations.
23 sea intercepts in G02 and 44 in G03 (up to 35%B per boat) drained lucas94 (B: 377k->237k at t=3000 in G02) and ryan_m (B: 530k->294k at t=3350..3510 in G03) right before enemy land pushes.
